title: The 5 Fastest Planets Around the Sun, Ranked (You're on #3)

scenes.text: You're flying around the Sun at 67,000 miles an hour. Two planets are even faster.

scenes.label: Jupiter · 29,000 mph
scenes.text: Number five: Jupiter. About twenty-nine thousand miles an hour, and it's the heaviest planet there is.

scenes.label: Mars · 54,000 mph
scenes.text: Number four: Mars. About fifty-four thousand miles an hour, a little under twice Jupiter's speed.

scenes.label: Earth · 67,000 mph
scenes.text: Number three: Earth. About sixty-seven thousand miles an hour. You're riding it right now and can't feel a thing.

scenes.label: Venus · 78,000 mph
scenes.text: Number two: Venus. About seventy-eight thousand miles an hour, circling the Sun in under eight months.

scenes.label: Mercury · 107,000 mph
scenes.text: Number one: Mercury. About one hundred seven thousand miles an hour, a lap of the Sun in just eighty-eight days.

description:
The five fastest planets, ranked by orbital speed around the Sun.
Mercury moves more than three times faster than Jupiter, and Earth is right in the middle.
Did you know you're moving this fast?
first_comment: Did you think Earth was this fast? Which space ranking should we do next?
